mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a temperature of 72 degrees with overcast skies near Fireman's Park and an air quality index of 51.

In city news, Mayor Luke Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month to support community health and equity. Additionally, expect some traffic delays on Highway M on Monday and Tuesday as crews perform necessary utility work.

Today is packed with action, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market and local live music spots like Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the Verona Area Kids Triathlon at the high school or the Girls Try Hockey event at the ice arena.

In our weekly look at local reports, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and cited the driver for possession of marijuana after detecting an odor inside the vehicle.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy their flavorful Mint Explosion! The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
